name: booking
description: Private tutor lesson requests and confirmations with participant-scoped rows. Entity rules do not enforce service validation on direct writes: learners can forge request details and assigned tutors can edit their rows.

tutor_profile_id.description: Approved tutor application profile for this lesson request

tutor_user_id.description: Assigned tutor account id used for tutor-only access

tutor_display_name.description: Public tutor name copied for a stable lesson-history label

learner_user_id.description: Learner account id used to retrieve the learner's own lessons

learner_first_name.description: First name derived from the signed-in learner account for the tutor's lesson list

start_time_utc.description: Lesson start as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp

end_time_utc.description: Lesson end as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp

duration_minutes.description: Requested lesson length in minutes: 30, 45, or 60

learner_message.description: Optional message written by the learner for the assigned tutor

status.description: Tutor-mediated request state; requests do not reserve a slot

decision_message.description: Stable decision-copy code translated in the interface

decision_at_utc.description: Tutor decision timestamp in UTC, empty while the request is pending
